+package trafficpolicy
+
+import (
+	"fmt"

+	envoyroutev3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/config/route/v3"

+
+type consistentHashIR struct {
+	disable      bool
+	hasSourceIp  bool
+	hashPolicies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+}
+
+var _ PolicySubIR = &consistentHashIR{}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) clone() *consistentHashIR {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	var clonedPolicies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	if c.hashPolicies != nil {
+		clonedPolicies = slices.Clone(c.hashPolicies)
+	}
+	return &consistentHashIR{
+		disable:      c.disable,
+		hasSourceIp:  c.hasSourceIp,
+		hashPolicies: clonedPolicies,
+	}
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Equals(other PolicySubIR) bool {
+	otherCH, ok := other.(*consistentHashIR)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c == nil && otherCH == nil {
+		return true
+	}
+	if c == nil || otherCH == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c.disable != otherCH.disable || c.hasSourceIp != otherCH.hasSourceIp {
+		return false
+	}
+	if !slices.EqualFunc(c.hashPolicies, otherCH.hashPolicies, func(a, b *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) bool {
+		return proto.Equal(a, b)
+	}) {
+		return false
+	}
+	return true
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Validate() error {
+	if c == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	for _, p := range c.hashPolicies {
+		if err := validateHashPolicy(p); err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func validateHashPolicy(p *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy) error {
+	if p == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+	if err := p.ValidateAll(); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if h := p.GetHeader(); h != nil && h.GetRegexRewrite() != nil && h.GetRegexRewrite().GetPattern() != nil {
+		if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(h.GetRegexRewrite().GetPattern().GetRegex()); err != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("invalid regex pattern: %w", err)
+		}
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) error {
+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return nil

+	ch := spec.ConsistentHash
+
+	if ptr.Deref(ch.Disable, false) {
+		if len(ch.Headers) > 0 || len(ch.Cookies) > 0 || len(ch.QueryParameters) > 0 || len(ch.FilterState) > 0 || ch.SourceIp != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("consistentHash: when disable is true, no other fields may be set")
+		}

+			disable: true,
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+

+	// 1. Headers (case-insensitive deduplication preserving first occurrence casing)

+		key := strings.ToLower(hdr.HeaderName)
+		if _, exists := seenHeaders[key]; exists {

+		seenHeaders[key] = struct{}{}
+

+			HeaderName: hdr.HeaderName,

+				return fmt.Errorf("consistentHash header %q: invalid regex pattern: %w", hdr.HeaderName, err)

+				Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{

+				},
+				Substitution: hdr.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+			}
+		}

+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{

+		})

+			continue
+		}
+		seenCookies[cookie.Name] = struct{}{}
+
+		cookieProto := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+			Name: cookie.Name,
+		}
+		if cookie.TTL != nil && *cookie.TTL != "" {
+			dur, err := parseCookieTTL(*cookie.TTL)
+			if err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("consistentHash cookie %q: invalid ttl %q: %w", cookie.Name, *cookie.TTL, err)
+			}
+			cookieProto.Ttl = durationpb.New(dur)
+		}
+		if cookie.Path != nil {
+			cookieProto.Path = *cookie.Path
+		}
+		if len(cookie.Attributes) > 0 {
+			attrs := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute, 0, len(cookie.Attributes))
+			for _, attr := range cookie.Attributes {
+				attrs = append(attrs, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+					Name:  attr.Name,
+					Value: attr.Value,
+				})
+			}
+			cookieProto.Attributes = attrs
+		}
+
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(cookie.Terminal, false),
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{
+				Cookie: cookieProto,
+			},
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 3. QueryParameters (deduplicated by name)
+	seenQP := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ch.QueryParameters))
+	for _, qp := range ch.QueryParameters {
+		if _, exists := seenQP[qp.Name]; exists {
+			continue
+		}
+		seenQP[qp.Name] = struct{}{}
+
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(qp.Terminal, false),
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+				QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+					Name: qp.Name,
+				},
+			},
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 4. FilterState (deduplicated by key)
+	seenFS := make(map[string]struct{}, len(ch.FilterState))
+	for _, fs := range ch.FilterState {
+		if _, exists := seenFS[fs.Key]; exists {
+			continue
+		}
+		seenFS[fs.Key] = struct{}{}
+
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(fs.Terminal, false),
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+				FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+					Key: fs.Key,
+				},
+			},
+		})
+	}
+
+	// 5. SourceIp
+	hasSourceIp := ch.SourceIp != nil
+	if ch.SourceIp != nil {
+		policies = append(policies, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			Terminal: ptr.Deref(ch.SourceIp.Terminal, false),
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+		})
+	}
+
+	out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+		disable:      false,
+		hasSourceIp:  hasSourceIp,
+		hashPolicies: policies,
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+func parseCookieTTL(raw string) (time.Duration, error) {
+	if secs, err := strconv.ParseInt(raw, 10, 64); err == nil {
+		return time.Duration(secs) * time.Second, nil
+	}
+	return time.ParseDuration(raw)
+}

+func defaultSourceIpHashPolicy() *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	return &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+		Terminal: false,
+		PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+			ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+				SourceIp: true,
+			},
+		},
+	}
+}
+
+func applyConsistentHash(ch *consistentHashIR, action *envoyroutev3.RouteAction) {
+	if ch == nil || action == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	if ch.disable {
+		action.HashPolicy = nil
+		return
+	}
+	if len(ch.hashPolicies) == 0 {
+		action.HashPolicy = []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{defaultSourceIpHashPolicy()}
+		return
+	}
+	action.HashPolicy = ch.hashPolicies
+}
+
+func mergeConsistentHashPolicies(high, low *consistentHashIR) *consistentHashIR {
+	if high == nil {
+		return low.clone()
+	}
+	if low == nil {
+		return high.clone()
+	}
+	if high.disable {
+		return &consistentHashIR{
+			disable: true,
+		}
+	}
+	if low.disable {
+		return high.clone()
+	}
+
+	var headers []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	var cookies []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	var queryParams []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	var filterStates []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+	var sourceIpPolicy *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+
+	seenHeaders := make(map[string]struct{})
+	seenCookies := make(map[string]struct{})
+	seenQP := make(map[string]struct{})
+	seenFS := make(map[string]struct{})
+
+	collectFrom := func(list []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, allowSourceIp bool) {
+		for _, p := range list {
+			switch spec := p.GetPolicySpecifier().(type) {
+			case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_:
+				key := strings.ToLower(spec.Header.GetHeaderName())
+				if _, exists := seenHeaders[key]; !exists {
+					seenHeaders[key] = struct{}{}
+					headers = append(headers, p)
+				}
+			case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_:
+				key := spec.Cookie.GetName()
+				if _, exists := seenCookies[key]; !exists {
+					seenCookies[key] = struct{}{}
+					cookies = append(cookies, p)
+				}
+			case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_:
+				key := spec.QueryParameter.GetName()
+				if _, exists := seenQP[key]; !exists {
+					seenQP[key] = struct{}{}
+					queryParams = append(queryParams, p)
+				}
+			case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_:
+				key := spec.FilterState.GetKey()
+				if _, exists := seenFS[key]; !exists {
+					seenFS[key] = struct{}{}
+					filterStates = append(filterStates, p)
+				}
+			case *envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_:
+				if allowSourceIp && sourceIpPolicy == nil {
+					sourceIpPolicy = p
+				}
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	// Higher-priority entries first; sourceIp scalar retains higher-priority policy's value even when unset.
+	collectFrom(high.hashPolicies, high.hasSourceIp)
+	collectFrom(low.hashPolicies, false)
+
+	merged := make([]*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy, 0, len(headers)+len(cookies)+len(queryParams)+len(filterStates)+1)
+	merged = append(merged, headers...)
+	merged = append(merged, cookies...)
+	merged = append(merged, queryParams...)
+	merged = append(merged, filterStates...)
+	if sourceIpPolicy != nil {
+		merged = append(merged, sourceIpPolicy)
+	}
+
+	return &consistentHashIR{
+		disable:      false,
+		hasSourceIp:  high.hasSourceIp,
+		hashPolicies: merged,
+	}
+}

+	p1, p2 *TrafficPolicy,
+	p2Ref *ir.AttachedPolicyRef,
+	p2MergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	opts policy.MergeOptions,
+	mergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	_ TrafficPolicyMergeOpts,
+) {

+	}

+		mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		return
+	}
+
+	switch opts.Strategy {
+	case policy.OverridableShallowMerge, policy.OverridableDeepMerge:
+		// p2 has higher priority (e.g., PreferParent)

+			mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+			return
+		}
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = mergeConsistentHashPolicies(p2.spec.consistentHash, p1.spec.consistentHash)
+		mergeOrigins.Append("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
